title: Industry Pulse — AI / Agent Ecosystem

bullets.title: OpenAI GPT-6.1 Sol launched 29 Sep at one-fifth of GPT-6 Astra's token price
bullets.summary: Near-Astra intelligence for coding and professional work, available to Plus/Pro/Business/Enterprise/Edu via ChatGPT Work and Codex.
bullets.how: The Construct: a much cheaper frontier-class alternative to benchmark against Sonnet 5.5 for volume agent jobs; keep the model layer swappable. PRAGMA: price compression strengthens the 'sell the orchestration, not the model' pitch.

bullets.title: Barclays scales Claude across the bank (announced 1 Oct)
bullets.summary: Claude Code targeted at 50% of developers by end-2026; live apps include a knowledge assistant for 16,000+ staff and an email-triage system handling ~120,000 messages a day.
bullets.how: PRAGMA: a named enterprise reference for the email-triage and internal-knowledge-assistant patterns — reuse as proof points in operator pitches. Brand 9 Signs: no direct fit.

bullets.title: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (28 Sep) — ~30% faster, up to 30% cheaper than Sonnet 5
bullets.summary: Still the key Anthropic release this week; Opus 5.5 (22 Sep) matches Fable 5.1 on most work at ~40% lower cost.
bullets.how: The Construct: route scheduled/high-volume jobs to Sonnet 5.5, keep Opus 5.5 for hard reasoning; verify model IDs before switching.

bullets.title: OpenAI 'dots' always-on agents (29 Sep) and Instinct's $1B raise at $10B
bullets.summary: Both land the same week: OpenAI ships goal-driven agents across 4,000+ apps while Sequoia/Benchmark/Coatue back Instinct's enterprise-agent bet.
bullets.how: PRAGMA: validates demand and crowding in the 'always-on operator' space — differentiate on SMB/vertical delivery and governance. The Construct: benchmark against our scheduled-job setup.

bullets.title: Google Gemini 4 'Argon' (30 Sep), limited to trusted cyber defenders for now
bullets.summary: Google claims state-of-the-art coding and knowledge results; pricing undisclosed, wider rollout later.
bullets.how: The Construct: nothing to wire yet — watch for GA and pricing before benchmarking for coding/long-running agents.

praxis_lesson: Frontier pricing fell again within 48 hours (Sonnet 5.5, then GPT-6.1 Sol at a fifth of Astra's price), so model choice is now a per-job cost lever, not a platform commitment. Keep every Construct job model-agnostic and route by task value.
